address: 66 Chiltern Street, Marylebone, London, W1U 4EJ, United Kingdom
bio: Named after one of Zeus's daughters, this chic Marylebone spot is a celebration of classic and contemporary Greek cuisine. Situated below luxury apartments, the buzzing interior has a faux-rustic look with plenty of tasteful Hellenic touches. The fresh flavours of the Mediterranean abound in dishes ranging from a deconstructed take on red prawn ‘saganaki’ to luscious suckling pig with a vibrant salsa. The concise and fairly priced wine list pushes Greek bottles to the fore, while the service team are as warm and friendly as they are attentive.
